notes.title: August Update: Fraggle Rock + Slingshot Mode!
notes.notes:
[b]SLINGSHOT MODE
[/b]Slingshot mode is a new activity at Welcome Island’s driving range where you’ll find new modes to try. This new feature is free and already in-game today! No need to update your game just jump in and enjoy! 

[b]FRAGGLE ROCK AVATAR PACK - $1.99 USD
[/b]*Purchasable In-Game only. Will not be on platform store pages, must be at the Welcome Island menu to purchase. 

Dance your cares away when you rock your favorite Fraggle avatar on your next mini golf adventure! Includes Gobo, Wembley, Red, Mokey and Boober.

[previewyoutube=ygoLINS8_2E;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]MEET THE FRAGGLES:
[/b]
Gobo
A dedicated explorer, Gobo keeps excitement constantly flowing through Fraggle Rock and is the only one brave enough to venture out!

Wembley
Have trouble making decisions? So does Wembley, but he's also the most positive, loyal friend you can have in Fraggle Rock, especially to Gobo, his bestest pal and cavemate!

Red
The tireless engine for fun in Fraggle Rock, Red is athletic, dependable, an incredible diver and swimmer — always chasing the next big activity to get things moving!

Mokey
A gentle, caring, artistic soul, in tune with the natural world and super aware of others feelings, Mokey is truly tapped into something special.

Boober
A sensitive, caring, incredible chef with a bit of a doomsday streak, Boober thrives on disaster prep and is always up for discussing the exciting world of cleanliness!

notes.title: June 2024 Player Update with Walkabout Creator
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38799938/8b6cd16cc43a9e63ad4ddf7c1c35435a2dbfdc8a.png[/img]
Hey everybody!

The year is halfway through and already so much has happened. Thank you so much for your ongoing support! I wanted to update everyone on what’s coming up for Walkabout Mini Golf…

We’ve recently announced that the “Wallace and Gromit” DLC is coming in July to Quest, PSVR2, Steam, and PICO players. It’s been a close partnership with Aardman and we think you’re going to love it! It’s chock full of gags, gadgets, and references from their many adventures. A few weeks ago we also announced our next licensed course: “[url=https://www.mightycoconut.com/blog/elvis]Viva Las Elvis[/url]” coming early 2025. But we have so many more surprises before then, including a handful of new courses.

On the tech side, [url=https://www.mightycoconut.com/pocket]Pocket Edition[/url] for iOS has taken much longer than we anticipated but we appreciate all who have participated in the Open Public Beta to help us get it right. That’s still very much in the works and we’ll get it out the moment it is ready. At the same time, we’ve spent much of the past 2 years rebuilding the code architecture to allow for more modes, features, and improvements that were never anticipated when Walkabout was originally created as a solo project. We really appreciate your patience as we have taken the time to do this the right way, and the new game modes that just released are the tip of the iceberg in terms of what we are now able to build on this more flexible system. Expect to see more features, quality-of-life improvements, and some surprises moving forward!

Also, we’ll soon be trying out a few licensed [url=https://www.mightycoconut.com/blog/elvis]avatar packs[/url] for $1.99, which will hopefully make it possible for us to pay for the licensing fees. This was inspired by the creative ways you all use our included avatars, and that library of included avatars will continue to expand. If enough of you like the licensed avatar packs, we’ll make more. If you don’t, we won’t. I know you all have many ideas for potential creative partners (as do we) and the best thing you can do to make those a reality is to keep playing and help spread the word. We are 100% independent, which means no investors, and we’re not reliant on things like ads or data mining to make our business work. Thanks to you, we’re totally player-funded, which allows us to make decisions based primarily on what delights you and us. Our goal is to keep this going by always evolving the game with you and the community at the center of our plans.

Thank you so much,

Lucas
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38799938/0a35a822387d3126f81d740848ba6602ff401360.png[/img]

notes.title: Pocket Edition Open Beta Test - OG Update!
notes.notes:
Gather round, putters!

[u][b]Our Open Beta test for iOS continues, only now, with a major update![/b][/u]

Putt through Original Gothic, our brand new course addition to this Beta, alongside our other base game delights.

You can also enjoy a new "Manage Downloads" button which allows you to choose the courses you have installed and uninstalled.

There are also various minor bug fixes to enhance your performance even more.

[url=https://forms.gle/AskLXofu9potZ5aP8]So what are you waiting for! There's still time to jump into our test below, accessed via the link at the end of the sign up form here.[/url]
[b][u]
Here Are Our Beloved Courses, Physics, and Social-Presence Features Again[/u][/b]

- Crossplay with iOS and VR (Quest, PS VR2, Steam, Pico).
- Suggested putting path.
- Mobile-specific UI/UX for navigation and menus.
- 8 unique 18-hole courses to master, each with hard variant.
- Collect lost balls.
- Unlock/collect putters by completing Hard Mode foxhunts.
- Play solo or in a private room you create or are invited to.
- Avatar customization.
- Localized in English, French, Spanish, German, Chinese, Japanese & Korean.
- Catalog of all base game courses and DLCs forthcoming.
- No ads nor micro-transactions.

[b]Note: this Beta is to test the iOS version of Walkabout Mini Golf and thus will be subject to change between now and its release. There may also be bugs/issues you encounter in said Beta which we'd love for you to report to us. More can be explained to you about the process itself, once contacted via email.[/b]

We look forward to welcoming many of you to our Open Beta test and to [url=discord.gg/wmg]Discord[/url], and be sure to join in the excitement on [url=www.twitter.com/walkaboutmg]X[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/walkaboutminigolf]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/walkaboutminigolf/]Instagram.[/url]

Till next time!

notes.title: Brand New Holiday Update!? Sleigh, What?!
notes.notes:
Oh the weather outside may be frightful, but in Walkabout Mini Golf, it’s anything but! 

After all, [b]we’ve maxed out our holiday cheer with this brand new update, decking our digital halls with a festive jingle, holiday avatars, and more[/b]. So, let’s break the ice and show you what’s in store!

[b][u]Wintry Welcome Island Takeover[/u][/b]

Sleigh bells are ringing on Welcome island with [b]a brand new holiday jingle[/b], composed by Coconut composer Chris Reyman! Use it as a backdrop when gathering with family and friends throughout the festive season, or use for content creation, dressed in one of our brand new holiday avatars.

[u][b]Holiday Avatars[/b][/u]

From dolls to dinosaur skulls, 2023 has been THE year for avatars, but we’re not done yet! Fright and delight your loved ones with our [b]horned Krampus avatar[/b], and serenade that special someone with our [b]mistletoe on a stick.[/b] Our [b]New Years glasses[/b] too, make the perfect accessory as you count down to 2024 with friends near and far. So what are you waiting for? Jump into Walkabout and see why these new avatars are TRULY love at frost sight.

[u][b]Meow Wolf Hole 18 Update[/b][/u]

You reported, and we listened! Alongside this wintry wonderland of updates, comes a fix for Meow Wolf’s Hole 18. For the few that kindly reported this issue to us, thank you, and be sure to portal jump once again into our latest DLC, to see your Hole 18 score soar.

So from all of us here at Walkabout Mini Golf, happy holidays! And do share the festive cheer with others on [url=twitter.com/walkaboutmg]X[/url], [url=instagram.com/walkaboutminigolf]Instagram[/url], [url=facebook.com/walkaboutminigolf]Facebook[/url], and [url=discord.gg/wmg]Discord.[/url]

Till 2024, 
Mighty Coconut

notes.title: 3.0 Patch
notes.notes:
Release Notes
We've just launched a free update to "Welcome Island," the main menu area where you start the game. Come enjoy a driving range mini game, an expansive putting practice area with the ability to pick up and even throw your ball, a raft ride, pool lounge, additional vacation-themed avatar hats, and several more quality of life features like the ability to mute individual players and settings in the main menu. Come check it out!

NEW FEATURES:
Redesign of starting area
Driving Range
Putting Practice Green w/Numbered Flags
New Avatar Items
You can now pick up the ball and throw it
Raft ride tour
New Mute Player Option
Game Settings and wrist watch feature now available at starting area
General bug fixes and performance improvements

Patch Update
Players flying around the driving range now have targets on them.
New loading icon
Fixes for a few states that would cause the ball to shoot up in unexpected directions 
Performance updates! 
Fix for UI on foxhunts not showing the correct count on the courses initial load. 
Fixed several areas that would cause the ball to get stuck in a invalid state. 
Blocked off a few areas where you could get the ball in the hole from underneath the geo.
Plus more bug fixes and under the hood tweaks!

notes.title: v2.95 - Sweetopia Release
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]New DLC Course: SWEETOPIA
[*]LIV support
[*]Course records are now full 18 (rather than front 9 + back 9). But your old scores will be automatically upgraded
[*]Lost balls and foxhunt clues you've already found appear as ghosted objects so you can help others find them
[*]In multiplayer, hitting trigger will usually take you to your own ball, rather than standing behind whoever's turn it is.
[*]The stroke limit is still 4 over par, but after hitting 3 over par it automatically adds one stroke and advances you to the next hole
[/list]

notes.title: v2.91 Release Notes - GUEST PASS Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] GUEST PASS - This is a brand new feature that will let people who haven't unlocked a course (either through gameplay, or purchasing a DLC) play as long as one person in a private room owns the course. However people in Guest Pass mode can't collect lost balls or complete foxhunts.
[*] Fixed ball falling through the floor of ramp on Shangri-La Hard #9 - This fix might affect physics slightly.
[*] Fixed issue where the join game dialogue doesn't always pop up when someone joins mid-match.
[/list]

notes.title: 2.8 HOTFIX
notes.notes:
New add-on course: "Gardens of Babylon."
Cloud save
Player Profiles: There are now 6 save slots for people sharing a headset
Localization: We now support English, French, Spanish, German, Japanese and Korean.
Bug fixes and performance improvements

HOTFIX UPDATE: This update should address issues some PC players have had accessing DLC, as well as a few minor things around profile, cloud saves and connectivity.

This hotfix also includes a RESTORE DATA button at the bottom of the profiles panel. This will try to retrieve whatever local data was stored from the previous version of the game, and put it in a new profile. So if you had multiple people playing on multiple devices, you should be able to create new profiles for each of them by clicking that button on each device.
